description.description: One-line summary. Text from the index: a reader escapes control characters before it prints.

id.description: Plugin id from the plugin manifest. `core` is reserved and never listed.

kind.description: `data` for a data plugin, `code` for a code plugin. The same values as the manifest kind.

name.description: Display name. Text from the index: a reader escapes control characters before it prints.

namespace.description: Publisher namespace that the key and the source are bound to. Same character set as a plugin id. `core` is reserved and never listed. An entry may claim `slopvac`, but only the compiled plugins key verifies that namespace.

slopvac_api.description: Lowest plugin extension API the host must implement. A host with a lower API cannot load the plugin. At most 4294967295, the bound the reader enforces. A whole number written with a fraction, such as 2.0, is an integer here and in the reader.

PackIndexSemver.description: Semantic version 2.0.0 without build metadata. Major, minor and patch have at most nine digits (at most 999999999), which is the bound the reader enforces. Otherwise the pattern is the `Semver` definition of `common.schema.json`.

PackIndexSource.description: Where to fetch the plugin: an oci:// reference, an https:// release archive URL, or a git+https:// URL pinned to a full commit hash after @. The URL carries no user-info. http:// and path sources are invalid: a public listing has no project root.

PublisherKey.description: The key the publisher signs with, for display. Never a trust anchor: a first install shows the fingerprint and waits for the explicit pinning command, and a pinned key wins over this value.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the raw public key bytes, 64 lowercase hex digits. This is the value that `slopvac plugins pin` takes.

key_id.description: Minisign key id, 16 uppercase hex digits.

description: The plugin index document that `slopvac plugins search` reads. A scheduled job rebuilds it from plugins that follow the naming convention. The index lists plugins for discovery and nothing more: it is not an authority for keys, and `publisher_key` is display-only (threat-model.md, section 5.2). A reader refuses a document over 32 MiB before it parses. Unknown keys are errors, and keys that start with `x-` are ignored. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/plugin-index.md.

plugins.description: One entry per plugin, sorted by namespace and then id, with no pair repeated. At most 100000 entries.

title: slopvac v3 plugin index
